shared_elements: standing/seated human figure in profile with elaborate headdress
large ornate headdress with scroll and plume elements
glyph-like signs in blocks or columns
figure holding a bar or staff-like object across the body
low-relief carved panel with single dominant human figure
justification: Both surfaces depict a single dominant elaborately costumed human figure in profile with an oversized plumed headdress and jewellery, holding a horizontal bar-like object across the chest, framed by columns/rows of small square glyph-blocks and a decorated border along the top and side — a very specific and conventional scheme unlikely to arise independently. The main differences are that A is far more eroded and shows the figure with a possible second smaller element at lower left, while B is more complete with a clearer full-length figure and a wider glyph column, but the underlying composition and relief conventions match closely.
